title: Skeleton Cabbage Detective
description: A skeletal figure wearing a fedora and trench coat sits atop a giant green cabbage, holding a bloody revolver. A blue beetle detective in a matching hat and coat floats above, examining the scene with a magnifying glass, surrounded by floating cabbage leaves, insects, and swirling dark vortex.
prompt: A skeletal detective wearing a fedora and trench coat sits on a giant cabbage, holding a dripping revolver. Above him, a large blue beetle detective in a suit and hat floats while holding a magnifying glass. They are surrounded by swirling vortex of green cabbage leaves and various insects against a dark background, in a surreal dark fantasy style with dramatic lighting and detailed textures.
